name: Fukui Tsuki
source:
Fukui Tsuki is super expressive and has unlimited energy. Even when she's on her non-sensical rambling, the atmosphere she brings is always unique and fun!

Tsuki, however, really wants to help others, even when she can't filter things properly. She's always supporting her friends!

[From [url=https://stefannofornari-games.itch.io/dont-give-up-on-me]itch.io[/url]]
